title: RIVALFRONT – a free 1v1 real-time strategy game that runs in your browser (play vs bots, no download)
author: zahrrpy
selftext:
Game Title: RIVALFRONT



Playable Link: [https://rivalfront.games/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=forum&utm\_campaign=rf\_playmygame\_20261007](https://rivalfront.games/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=forum&utm_campaign=rf_playmygame_20261007)



Platform: Browser (desktop with mouse and keyboard; tablets and phones in landscape)

Description:

RIVALFRONT is a 1v1 real-time strategy game built for the browser. Two factions fight the same war in different ways: the Konsortium holds ground with armour and fortified positions, the Kollektiv wins with numbers and tempo. Both grow through three tech tiers with ground and air units.



You can start a bot match straight away: pick a difficulty (Recruit, Soldier or Veteran) and one of six battlefields. Guided lessons teach the controls and each faction's style, and two story campaigns add twelve missions. Every match can be reviewed and replayed in the browser.



Online 1v1 is in closed alpha, so for now you play against bots. The game is free with no limits; the shop sells cosmetics only.



Two things I'd love to hear from you: was your first match clear without reading anything? And which faction felt better, and why? Feedback is also welcome on our Discord: [https://discord.gg/arfbpmTpsw](https://discord.gg/arfbpmTpsw)

  
I'm the lead developer. Design, direction and decisions are mine. Concept art and the 3D models were made with AI tools (image generation, Meshy) and reviewed and edited by us; development uses AI coding assistants.
